title: pvThresholdTable
body:
## pvThresholdTable

Keeps the rows of a table (vtkTable) whose value in one numeric column satisfies a threshold: below MaxValue, above MinValue, between them, or outside them. The output is a table with the same columns and the same or fewer rows. Use it to filter CSV data, statistics output or probe tables; use threshold or pvThreshold for meshes.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The column must be a single-component numeric array.
- MinValue and MaxValue may be initialized by ParaView from the column range; set the ones the chosen Mode uses.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ThresholdTable`. Identity: `filters/ThresholdTable`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Threshold Table filter. Accepted data: tables (rows and columns) (vtkTable). The input needs at least one point- or cell-centred array with 1 component. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkTable"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Column` | This property specifies which column to use for thresholding. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `MaxValue` | The value of this property specifies the upper bound of the thresholding operation. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `MinValue` | The value of this property specifies the lower bound of the thresholding operation. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `Mode` | This property indicates the threshold method. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Below Max Threshold","Above Min Threshold","Between","Outside"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Below Max Threshold"` |

  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
